title: Staged Renewal Bands + Fast‑Track SQ Integration for Private/VPC Packaging
creator: Priya Menon
description: Problem: Sales and procurement for Private/VPC & on‑prem customers are delayed by two main friction points: (1) legal/finance pushback on large up‑front license fees and (2) long security questionnaire (SQ) cycles that block PO/contract signature. Objective: Run an experiment that (A) introduces a staged renewal (two-band) license fee that reduces initial sticker shock while preserving ARR, and (B) embeds a fast‑track SQ intake and automated pre‑screen to reduce SQ cycle time for low‑risk deployments. This ticket captures the product design, measurement plan, and implementation coordination with sales, legal, and security teams.
acceptance_criteria: Pilot package with staged renewal pricing defined: initial license fee = 60% of 12‑month equivalent, renewal band = 40% billed at renewal window
Fast‑track SQ flow implemented in procurement intake form and connected to automated pre‑screen rules (low/medium/high risk buckets)
Sales pilot (n=8 deals) executed with defined control group and experiment group
Metrics baseline and instrumentation in place: sales cycle days, legal SQ days, conversion rate, ARR retention at 12 months
Legal and Security approval recorded for pilot contract templates and pre‑screen scoring thresholds
